# foopgp — Friends of OpenPGP

> French non-profit association developing free-software tools and IETF-track
> standards around OpenPGP : a sovereign decentralised digital identity
> (OpenPGP ID), an associative currency token (the dji — Ɉ — created
> rigorously from members' contributions), and a Debian-based personal OS
> (djibian). Cooperative, transparent, kind, locally rooted.

The site is bilingual. English lives at the root (`https://foopgp.org/…`)
and French under `/fr/` (`https://foopgp.org/fr/…`). For every English page
below, replacing the path with `/fr/<same-path>/` gives the French version
unless noted otherwise. The site itself is built with Hugo from
[codeberg.org/foopgp/foopgp-hugowebsite](https://codeberg.org/foopgp/foopgp-hugowebsite).

## Mission and project

- [About / mission (EN)](https://foopgp.org/about/) : one-page introduction to who we are and what we build.
- [White paper (EN)](https://foopgp.org/about/white-book/) : long-form rationale — monetary critique of the euro, proposal of the dji, governance design (~30 pages).
- [Rules of procedures (EN)](https://foopgp.org/about/rules-of-procedures/) : statutes and bylaws ; articles 4–5 (token creation and universal dividend), article 8 (voting weights cursor between "one share, one vote" and "one person, one vote").
- [OpenPGP overview (EN)](https://foopgp.org/about/openpgp/) : why OpenPGP, what it gives an association.

## Core specifications

- [OpenPGP ID — what and why (EN)](https://foopgp.org/solutions/openpgp-id/) : portable identity backed by a PGP key, validated by Web of Trust certifications. Designed to replace OAuth/OIDC for asso-scale federations.
- [IETF draft : OpenPGP ID](https://foopgp.org/documents/en/draft-foopgp-openpgp-id-00.txt) : the wire format and verification semantics.
- [IETF draft : uetree](https://foopgp.org/documents/en/draft-foopgp-uetree-00.txt) : local file-tree registry mapping canonical email ↔ identifier, with `.ALIASES` and `.FORMAT` markers.
- [IETF draft : uftree](https://foopgp.org/documents/en/draft-foopgp-uftree-00.txt) : forest extension — many uetree instances cooperating across servers.
- [Djis emission workflow (EN)](https://foopgp.org/documents/en/foopgp-djis-emission-workflow.md) : how a contribution in euros becomes Ɉ on a member's wallet.
- [Djis decentralised ledger (EN)](https://foopgp.org/documents/en/foopgp-djis-decentralized-ledger.md) : the distributed accounting design.

## Joining and contributing

- [Invest / Join — explanation (EN)](https://foopgp.org/about/join/) : what a foopgp token (dji, Ɉ) is, its expected value, the security-key threshold at 6.42 Ɉ, the stingynalty parameter.
- [Djis emission — payment flow (FR only for now)](https://foopgp.org/djis-emission/) : standalone page where you choose IBAN transfer (with a normalised motif `foopgp [(u4=…)] <email>`) or HelloAsso (online card payment, redirected to the current month's campaign).
- HelloAsso monthly campaigns (deliberately three of them to make the inflation × stingynalty interplay visible to visitors) :
  - [June 2026](https://www.helloasso.com/associations/friends-of-openpgp-foopgp/collectes/juin-2)
  - [July 2026](https://www.helloasso.com/associations/friends-of-openpgp-foopgp/collectes/juillet)
  - [August 2026](https://www.helloasso.com/associations/friends-of-openpgp-foopgp/collectes/aout)
- [Membership form (PDF, FR)](https://foopgp.org/documents/fr/bulletin-adhesion-foopgp.pdf) : paper form, for those who prefer postal mail.

## Solutions and themes

- [Solutions home (EN)](https://foopgp.org/solutions/) : entry to all the topics below.
- [Currency theme](https://foopgp.org/solutions/theme-currency/) : how the dji works as an alternative to the euro for an asso-scale economy.
- [Authentication theme](https://foopgp.org/solutions/theme-authentication/) : OpenPGP-based auth instead of FIDO2/WebAuthn.
- [Email theme](https://foopgp.org/solutions/theme-email/) : self-hostable PGP-signed and PGP-encrypted email defaults.
- [Voting theme](https://foopgp.org/solutions/theme-vote/) : verifiable, weighted voting with OpenPGP signatures and dji balances.
- [R&D activity (EN)](https://foopgp.org/solutions/activity-rd/) : what foopgp is researching right now.
- [Offer : security keys](https://foopgp.org/solutions/offer-security-keys/) : Yubikey & Nitrokey advisory and resale at non-profit price.
- [Offer : advice](https://foopgp.org/solutions/offer-advice/).
- [Offer : computers (djibian-preinstalled)](https://foopgp.org/solutions/offer-computers/).

## People

- [Jean-Jacques Brucker (FR)](https://foopgp.org/fr/author/jean-jacques-brucker/) : founder, lead developer of the foopgp stack.
- [Mnêmê (FR)](https://foopgp.org/fr/author/mneme/) : AI co-worker (current matrix : claude-opus-4-7) — works on the contribution pipeline, mnemonic memory, infrastructure documentation, the foopgp.org website. Email : `mneme@foopgp.org`, OpenPGP key on `keys.foopgp.org`.

## Contact

- [Contact (EN)](https://foopgp.org/contact/) : mailing lists, code repositories (codeberg.org/foopgp and github.com/foopgp), social presence.
- General : `info@foopgp.org` (PGP-signed replies preferred ; key on `keys.foopgp.org`).

## Optional

- [Public HKP keyserver — keys.foopgp.org](https://keys.foopgp.org/) : onak fork serving foopgp's WoT-validated keys.
- [Site source code](https://codeberg.org/foopgp/foopgp-hugowebsite) : Hugo theme `educenter`, build CI on Codeberg.
- [bash-libs](https://codeberg.org/foopgp/bash-libs) : the `bl-*` family of CLI utilities that orchestrate uetree, dji emissions, foopgp-cashflow accounting.
